ar.title: إمام بايلدي مع لحم مفروم وزبادي
ar.intro: "إمام بايلدي" معناها "الإمام أغمي عليه" باللغة التركية، طبق شهير جداً.

steps.n1: قطّع وامِلح وصفِّ الباذنجان، ثم اقليه بالزيت العميق حتى يصبح بنياً غامقاً.
steps.n2: اسمّر البصل بقليل زيت، أضف اللحم مع الملح والفلفل واطهِه حتى تُمتص عصائره.
steps.n3: ضع اللحم والباذنجان المقلي في قدر على نار منخفضة واطهِ مع التحريك كثيراً حتى يتحلل الباذنجان تماماً.
steps.n4: اضغط المزيج على جانب القدر بملعقة خشبية لعصر الدهن الزائد وصبّه.
steps.n5: انشر في طبق ضحل. امزج الزبادي مع الثوم وقليل ملح وانشره في الأعلى.
steps.n6: رشّ الجوز وقدّم ساخناً أو بارداً.

en.title: Imam Bayildi with Minced Beef and Yogurt
en.intro: Recipe 155, page 71 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Slice, salt and drain the eggplants, then deep-fry them until dark brown.
steps.n2: Brown the onion in a little oil, add the beef with salt and pepper and cook until its juices are absorbed.
steps.n3: Put the meat and fried eggplant in a pot over a low heat and cook, stirring often, until the eggplant has completely broken down.
steps.n4: Press the mixture against the side of the pot with a wooden spoon to squeeze out excess fat, and pour it off.
steps.n5: Spread in a shallow dish. Mix the yogurt with the garlic and a little salt and spread it over the top.
steps.n6: Sprinkle with the nuts and serve hot or cold.

legacySteps: Slice, salt and drain the eggplants, then deep-fry them until dark brown.
Brown the onion in a little oil, add the beef with salt and pepper and cook until its juices are absorbed.
Put the meat and fried eggplant in a pot over a low heat and cook, stirring often, until the eggplant has completely broken down.
Press the mixture against the side of the pot with a wooden spoon to squeeze out excess fat, and pour it off.
Spread in a shallow dish. Mix the yogurt with the garlic and a little salt and spread it over the top.
Sprinkle with the nuts and serve hot or cold.
